title: why Japan's internet is weirdly designed
summary: Answer in Progress investigates why Japanese websites look different from those elsewhere, using an AI clustering approach to test the 2013 claim. It then looks at possible explanations.
why: Cited as a companion to articles on Japanese web design and as an example of clustering websites by appearance.

quote.text: It's not an explanation, but show a possible way to cluster (thus classify) websites based on the how they appear
